plain: The power of an argument to persuade.

webster.text: Force; strength; power of compelling; literally, urgency, or driving.

example.quote: The arguments used on that occasion apply with more cogency to our situation.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
